The exporter turned every bucket into the same series, so each scrape logged dozens to hundreds of collection errors and dropped them. The first release of Dbento, a native, GPU-rendered database client written in Rust. It connects to Postgres, SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB and DuckDB. Your connections live in a plain `dbento.toml` you can keep in git, and passwords stay in the OS keychain. The release ships the desktop app, the `dbento` command line and its MCP server.
